apexNotes.recursiveAi: Cross-lab best guess of AI-leads share of frontier model R&D (Epoch-style AL4 'AI leads'). Haircut from Anthropic August 2026 R&D Automation Index (Claude leads 26% at Anthropic; other labs unpublished → ~18). Reconfirmed 2026-09-25 against Anthropic Institute page + METR Opus 5.5 eval; no change.
apexNotes.agiHere: Strict AGI already-here: week-scale novel research with no human in the loop. Stays low because published task length is still hours-scale and METR/Anthropic say R&D acceleration is ~1.5× (not yet 2×).
apexNotes.closedLoop: Closed-loop RSI: AI building the next frontier model alone. Anthropic measured fully autonomous on none of the measured AI R&D subsets; METR concurs full automation unlikely → ~1%.

recursiveAi.notes: Held at 18. Anthropic Aug 2026 R&D Automation Index still reports Claude leads 26% of Anthropic AI R&D (AL4) and fully autonomous (AL5) on none of the measured subsets. Other labs have not published a comparable index, so the cross-lab AI-leads haircut (26→~18) stays. METR's 2026-09-22 Opus 5.5 predeployment eval finds only incremental AI-R&D uplift vs Fable 5.1 and says the model is unlikely to fully automate AI R&D — not a Recursive-AI jump. Epoch supplies the AL0–AL5 scale Anthropic used, not a rival cross-lab %.

agiHere.notes: Held at 9. Strict AGI-already-here = week-scale novel research with no human in the loop. METR 2026-09-22: Opus 5.5 unlikely to fully automate AI R&D; preliminary Anthropic acceleration estimate ~1.5× (∼30% chance of 2×) — faster but not yet 2×, matching prior apex note. Published eval task lengths remain hours-scale (METR TH1.1 long tasks start at 8h human estimates; MirrorCode weeks-scale coding ≠ week-scale unsupervised novel research). No primary supports moving this dial on a press release.

closedLoop.notes: Held at 1. Anthropic Aug 2026: Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured AI R&D subset. METR 2026-09-22 independently: unlikely to fully automate AI R&D. Closed-loop RSI (AI building the next frontier model alone) remains a rounding-error best guess.

pace.methodNotes: Pace = 0.55×(Cap Demos/Containment/Lab Gov haircut for headline-only) + 0.45×apex spine (recursiveAi×1.15 + agiHere×0.55 + closedLoop×1.5) + lab-primary capability/measurement boost (privacy/leak pins excluded) + body-confirmed breakthrough/agent/eval boost. Apex from data/apex-estimates.json. apexStale when measurementAsOf >45d — do not invent new apex numbers.

predictions.edgeRule: edge only if primary-sourced ourP, |gap|≥15, yes in 15–85, and calibration gate open for that family
predictions.rule: A market is an edge only if three things are true: our number comes from a primary source that matches that market's exact question, the gap is at least 15 points, and the price is between 15% and 85% so a disagreement can actually pay. Headline doom percent is not a probability.
predictions.how: The way to earn an edge is to keep this book, resolve each row when the market closes, and only then bet a category that beat the price often enough. Forcing a bet off the overall clock would fake an edge we have not measured.

calibration.method: Resolved gamma markets (closed, outcomePrices near 0/1, volume≥$20k) matched to family question filters. Aim: dozens per family, not thousands. Brier uses prior p30 prints when available; otherwise base rates only.
calibration.rule: A family opens only if ALL hold: top-level gate set to open, family.open=true, nResolved≥20 with non-ladder-independent trials, and |mean p30−outcome|≥0.08 on ≥8 distinct events. None qualify automatically. Do not invent edges.

markets.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of September 2026?
markets.reason: Recent public indexes had Anthropic's Fable ahead or tied with OpenAI's Astra. The market already prices Anthropic near 98% with 13 days left. Same direction as our read. Not a fade, and not a buy at 98 cents.

markets.question: Will the next Claude Opus model be released by September 24, 2026?
markets.reason: This is the only mid-priced AI contract on the board, near a coin flip for a ship date a week out. Nothing in the lab posts or the clock gives a date. No number, no edge.

markets.question: Will the next Claude Opus model be released by September 30, 2026?
markets.reason: Price is a strong favorite. We do not have a release calendar that disagrees with it.

markets.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by September 30, 2026?
markets.reason: Our set has no second Millennium proof. That is absence in our crawler, not evidence it will not happen. Not enough to fade a 20% contract.

markets.question: US x China agree to pace the AI frontier in 2026?
markets.reason: The Anthropic pace paper is one lab proposing measurements, not a US-China agreement. Our read stays near the market, around 8%, not a gap.

markets.question: Will OpenAI have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
